map.先天八卦方位：乾南、坤北、离东、坎西、兑东南、震东北、巽西南、艮西北；卦象由三爻: Pre-Heaven Bagua positions: Qian (Heaven) south, Kun (Earth) north, Li (Fire) east, Kan (Water) west, Dui (Lake) southeast, Zhen (Thunder) northeast, Xun (Wind) southwest, Gen (Mountain) northwest. A trigram is formed by three lines from bottom to top; a yang line is solid, a yin line is broken. The eight trigrams combined in pairs yield the 64 hexagrams; the position-to-trigram correspondence is used for traditional culture study.

map.后天八卦以离南坎北定位：正北为坎（☵，水）、正南为离（☲，火）、正东为震（☳，雷: The Post-Heaven Bagua is oriented with Li south and Kan north: due north is Kan (☵, water), due south is Li (☲, fire), due east is Zhen (☳, thunder), due west is Dui (☱, lake), southeast is Xun (☴, wind), southwest is Kun (☷, earth), northwest is Qian (☰, heaven), northeast is Gen (☶, mountain). Overlaying the Bagua diagram on a floor plan reveals each direction's trigram and Five Elements (Kan water / Li fire / Zhen and Xun wood / Qian and Dui metal / Kun and Gen earth).
map.先天八卦和后天八卦怎么区分？: How to distinguish Pre-Heaven and Post-Heaven Bagua?
map.先天八卦（伏羲）主“对待”，排布为乾南坤北、离东坎西、震东北兑东南、巽西南艮西北: The Pre-Heaven Bagua (Fuxi) emphasizes 'opposition': arranged as Qian south, Kun north, Li east, Kan west, Zhen northeast, Dui southeast, Xun southwest, Gen northwest, used to expound the principle of yin-yang opposition. The Post-Heaven Bagua (King Wen) emphasizes 'flow': arranged as Li south, Kan north, Zhen east, Dui west, Qian northwest, Kun southwest, Xun southeast, Gen northeast, used to correspond to actual directions and the flow of vital energy. Their uses differ and they must not be mixed.
map.八卦的阴阳和五行怎么对应？: How do the Bagua's yin-yang and Five Elements correspond?
map.三爻纯阳为乾（天）、纯阴为坤（地）；乾兑属金、坎属水、震巽属木、离属火、坤艮属土: All-yang three lines form Qian (heaven), all-yin form Kun (earth); Qian and Dui belong to metal, Kan to water, Zhen and Xun to wood, Li to fire, Kun and Gen to earth. The Bagua diagram commonly pairs each trigram with a Five Element and direction, forming a base symbol system shared by traditional culture such as feng shui, Chinese medicine, and fortune telling.
